title: Managing Change Orders and Contractual Claims
overview: This course is designed to provide participants with foundational knowledge and essential skills to effectively address claims, variations, and disputes between principals and contractors. Through this interactive program, participants will learn to analyze contractual issues, apply techniques for managing challenging situations, and adopt best practices to resolve disputes amicably.
audience: This course is ideal for professionals involved in contract implementation, administration, claims, and change order management, as well as those managing disputes with contracting parties. It is also beneficial for anyone interested in preventing or resolving contractual issues.
methodology: The course combines individual and group exercises to enhance understanding of key contract management activities. It includes case studies, participant presentations, role-playing, and discussions to foster practical learning. Pre- and post-course assessments are conducted to measure progress.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify and mitigate the causes of contractual claims and change orders.
Draft variation orders and notices of breach for major types of change orders.
Analyze and manage various owners' and contractors' claims effectively.
Apply collaborative approaches to handle claims, variation orders, and conflicts.
Use negotiation techniques to resolve disputes and reach final settlements.
